_timeline_shift: [Антон 21:26: соло выше среднего по сложности, злодеи регулярно ломают здания] threat every 100 s; first raid 2:30 then every 60 s; heroes self-open at 3:20 / 6:40 / 8:20, call target 11:00; novice target win 13–17 min with some losses, experienced 9–12 min

unlocks.intern: campaign shifts 1–4 use it; free choice after campaign shift 12

records: best time is kept per difficulty

noGuess.fallback: move one site from the stuck ambiguous frontier to a random cell that keeps the board solvable; if still stuck after 200 attempts accept board and log

raidRules.source: every opened (revealed, not destroyed) nest or heavy_nest; if none opened, a hidden nest nearest to the player's buildings opens a tunnel and sends the raid from there (its cell is shown as threat ping)
raidRules.target: player building nearest to the source, command center last unless it is the only one
raidRules.warningUi: red arrow at screen edge + sound raid_incoming
raidRules._note: raids are what makes villains regularly smash buildings
raidRules.tunnelExit: if the source nest is closer than 6 cells to any player building, raiders surface at a revealed or closed cell 6 cells away along the line from the target; they wait there until the siren has run 10 s
raidRules._b3: QA B-3: reactor fell 4 s after the toast, home in the same second

callEarly.nextTimer: normal interval counted from the called raid
callEarly.internWithoutRaids: button «Позвать рейд» still offered; raid uses shift rules

buildingDamage._note: разрушенное здание оставляет руины, отстроить можно за полцены
